# The client asked for "one more thing." Price it.

> Price a client's extra requests on a fixed-price project as a change order, see what absorbing them would cost your hourly rate, and copy a client-ready message. Free, private, runs in your browser; CLI included.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/scope-creep-change-order-calculator/)
- [How to price a change order on a fixed-price project](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/scope-creep-change-order-calculator/how-to-price-a-change-order.html)
